about_the_game:
​​Beasts of Admiral: Reborn​

Where Steel Clashes with Dragon Roars in an Alternate 1894

​​WORLD OF MAGIC FALLEN: THE WAR OF STEEL AND DRAGON'S ROAR​​

When a magical meteor shattered the Mediterranean in the 17th century, torrents of arcane energy rewrote human history—

Western nations ignited a ​​"Thaumaturgical Revolution"​​, infusing steam cores with magical forces, catapulting productivity through enchanted gears and runes.

Yet in the East, the secluded Qing Empire struggled in stagnation. Even with their ​​"Magical Self-Strengthening Movement"​​—taming Western sea beasts to rebuild the Beiyang Fleet—the decaying empire remained shrouded in the shadow of technological inferiority.

What now prowls the waves of the Yellow Sea?

No longer ironclads, but ​​organic leviathans bound by dark contracts​​!

Sailors ride Western dragons breathing magical fire, clashing against the Japanese fleet and their own summoned horrors in primal, tooth-and-claw combat.

You, the time-traveler, awaken in the blood-soaked year of ​​1894​​ as ​​Admiral Ding Ruchang​​.

Before you lies the aftermath of the Yellow Sea defeat: ships shattered, beasts dying, while the modernized claws of Meiji Japan tear at the heart of China.

Now, take command of eight wounded sea creatures, develop arcane tanks, and rewrite fate amidst the roar of steel and magic!

​​HIGHLIGHTS​​

​​► Lead a Magical Army​​

Command war beasts, arcane tanks, knights, and spellcasters. Deploy them across strategic battlefields to ambush and overturn the tides of war.

​​► Relive the Sino-Japanese War—Reimagined​​

Immerse yourself in a magically recreated 1894:

  • The fortified artillery of Weihaiwei

  • The shikigami-guarded naval yards of Nagasaki

  • The forbidden arts lurking in Hanseong

  • Every choice you make shifts the course of history.

​​"Beasts of Admiral: Reborn"​​

A redemption song of history, and a strategic fantasy reborn!

​​KEY FEATURES​​

  • ​​Beast & Mech Hybrid Warfare​​: Direct both tamed monsters and steam-powered tanks in large-scale battles.

  • ​​Branching Narrative​​: Decide the fate of nations through diplomacy, research, and battlefield victories.

​​Wishlist Now on Steam!​​

Prepare to change history—when magic meets the age of steam.

short_description: ​​Dragons roar, history bends. As Admiral Ding Ruchang, you command magical sea beasts, not ships, in this thrilling SRPG. After a crushing defeat, lead the Beiyang Fleet's last hope against Japan's monsters. Rewrite the Sino-Japanese War.
